opt_1:
What I liked most about the adaptive website was the personalization and the overall improvement in the user experience compared to the first system. After answering the preference and personality questions, the website felt more tailored to me rather than showing the same experience to every user. The colors were clearer and more visually appealing, and the interface felt more organized and easier to understand. I also liked that the recommendations and the way the shopping experience was presented seemed to reflect some of the information I provided earlier. This made the system feel more interactive and engaging.

I also liked that the website still kept the useful e-commerce features, such as product ratings, discounts, Favorites, filtering, search, and the “Deal of the Week” section. The adaptive version made these features feel more connected and easier to explore. In general, I preferred System 2 because it felt clearer, more user-friendly, and more personalized, and I could clearly see the potential of using adaptive interfaces to improve online shopping experiences.
opt_2:
I would mainly improve some of the usability details and technical consistency. Although the adaptive website provided a better overall experience, some elements could still be made clearer. For example, validation messages should appear directly below the field or selection that caused the issue, preferably in red, rather than appearing at the top of the page. This would make it immediately clear to the user what needs to be corrected.

I would also improve the consistency of product images and interactions. In some cases, product images did not load correctly, and when selecting a different product color, the selected color was registered but the product image did not visually update. These are relatively small issues, but fixing them would make the website feel more complete and reliable. I would also make sure that the personalization is clearly reflected throughout the whole shopping journey so the user can easily understand how the experience has been adapted to their preferences.
opt_3:
If I could improve only one aspect, I would focus on making the personalization even more noticeable, consistent, and meaningful throughout the website. The personalized experience was the feature I liked most, so I think strengthening it would have the biggest impact. For example, the system could make it clearer why certain products, offers, layouts, or recommendations are being shown based on the user’s preferences.

I think the idea itself is very promising because personalization can make online shopping feel easier and more relevant instead of forcing users to search through many products that may not interest them. If the adaptive behavior becomes more consistent across recommendations, product ordering, offers, and interface elements, while still keeping the design simple and clear, I think the system could provide a really strong and enjoyable shopping experience ❤️
